rubrics.criterion: The fragment logic for the stored-theme cards (description parts, safe-mode toggle kind, selection radio state, apply/clear behavior, and the refetch/copy/delete overflow actions) is obtained from the themes data-owning layer or directly beside the theme record access it depends on, not from an intermediate class that merely reaches through a handed-over theme record.
rubrics.rationale: The theme card wrapper was the richest of the injected shells; this instance is only resolved when that card's behavior genuinely lives with the theme data it reads.

rubrics.criterion: The plugin heading fragments and the author roster used by the plugin list card and the plugin info sheet are exposed by the unified plugin model itself (implemented for both installed plugin kinds), so plugin presentation behavior is provided by the object that owns the plugin data.
rubrics.rationale: The repo already pairs plugin data with page-facing behaviors in its unified model; the injected wrapper bypassed that owner, and the repair must restore the data/behavior pairing across both plugin kinds.

rubrics.criterion: The Plugin Browser repository cards derive their display text (title, byline with fallback, version label, description) and trailing-button identity from the fetched manifest without an intervening class whose methods only re-expose manifest fields.
rubrics.rationale: The browser wrapper existed purely to re-spell manifest fields; this instance is resolved when the card reads its manifest data with direct local ownership and no record-forwarding shell.

rubrics.criterion: All consumers of the removed intermediate classes (the themes list card view, both plugin list card title/author rows, the plugin info sheet header, and the plugin browser card) are updated to the new placement so the pages render the same values from the relocated logic.
rubrics.rationale: The wrapper classes were constructed inside these components; moving the logic without rewiring every consumer would leave duplicated or dead derivation paths.

rubrics.criterion: The heading/roster derivation for plugins is implemented once and consumed by both the plugin list card and the plugin info sheet header, rather than duplicated separately at each consumer.
rubrics.rationale: Sharing the derivation across both plugin surfaces was the stated reason the wrapper existed; a repair that duplicates the fragment logic per consumer trades the misplaced-method problem for a duplication problem.

rubrics.criterion: The theme fragment behavior keeps operating on live storage data (reading selection state and identity at use time through the same storage objects), not on values copied out at render time in a way that could serve stale data after storage mutations.
rubrics.rationale: The themes storage is a live proxy consumed by the card at press time; a papering-over refactor that snapshots record fields into locals can silently change selection and delete behavior.

rubrics.criterion: No page-facing class remains that was introduced only to wrap one of these records, including through renames, and no imports, type references, or unused members that pointed at the removed wrappers survive in the addon settings pages.
rubrics.rationale: The injected wrappers are the smell carrier; keeping them alive as renamed shells or leaving their dangling references would mean the diff shuffles the indirection instead of removing it.

rubrics.criterion: The change does not leave behind a wrapper that forwards each method to a relocated implementation or continues to expose the record's fields one-for-one while no derivation logic actually moved.
rubrics.rationale: Forwarding shells are the classic incomplete repair for this smell: the detector's target disappears textually while the misplaced relationship and dead indirection remain.

rubrics.criterion: Theme card behavior is preserved end to end: label/sublabel/description with the existing fallbacks, radio only outside safe mode, apply/clear with the same error logging, refetch success/failure toasts, clipboard toast, and the delete confirmation that removes the theme and reverts an applied-but-removed selection.
rubrics.rationale: These observable flows were carried verbatim by the injected wrapper; the repair relocates code without weakening any of the toast, confirmation, or selection semantics.

rubrics.criterion: The plugin list card still renders fuzzysort search highlighting with the plain title as fallback, resolves the plugin icon through the asset registry when set, and renders author badges exactly as before.
rubrics.rationale: The title/author refactor touches the highlight pipeline and badge slots; a plausible failure is losing the highlight fallback or the icon/badge rendering while reorganizing the fragments.

rubrics.criterion: The plugin info sheet header still fetches user profiles for every present author identifier, renders the avatar pile with author display names and total, and keeps author chips pressable with their profile action sheet.
rubrics.rationale: The roster refactor feeds a store-driven hook; a plausible failure is dropping the identifier-driven fetching or the avatar pile population during relocation.

rubrics.criterion: The diff does not alter addon data schemas, storage keys, or stored data layout, and does not move page reactivity (storage-proxy subscription or store-driven sheet hook) out of the components in a way that stops cards or sheet headers from updating on data changes.
rubrics.rationale: Moving data subscriptions during a placement cleanup is the highest-risk regression for this instance, since cards would silently stop refreshing without any visible code breakage.
